decisions.reason: The charting bundle has not appeared on the website since 2020, which weakens the signal about its value, but as a plugin on the established map.apps platform it costs little to maintain and still gives an option for customer projects.

The hierarchical search bundle only ever had a brief mention and has not been visible for several years, so the evidence suggests its value will not be realized and its maintenance effort is better spent on the core platform.
The software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic base for its other products, so it is a core commitment rather than a marginal option and abandoning it is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's enterprise GIS offer and public-sector demand, so despite less visibility on the website its low holding cost justifies keeping the option open.
